PREVIOUSLY ON THE X-FILES...
THIS ACT WILL BEGIN WITH A RECAP OF THE TWO-PART SEASON FINALE,
FOR WHICH THIS EPISODE COMPLETES A QUARTET. MOST IMPORTANTLY, WE
SEE SCULLY'S FEAR ABOUT HER PREGNANCY, AND AGENT DOGGETT'S AND —
AGENT MULDER'S CALL TO ARMS WHEN HER UNBORN CHILD (PRODUCED |
MIRACULOUSLY TO A BARREN SCULLY). IS CONNECTED TO A GOVERNMENT
MEDICAL FACILITY CONDUCTING ADVANCED GENETICS AND HUMAN CLONING
EXPERIMENTS. AN OLD MILITARY ASSOCIATE OF DOGGETT'S TELLS HIM
IT'S PART OF A GOVERNMENT CONSPIRACY TO CREATE A "SUPER
SOLDIER". MULDER BELIEVES OTHERWISE, MAKING AN ALIEN CONNECTION.
BUT WHATEVER THE TRUTH, IT INVOLVES ALEX KRYCEK, AND LEADS TO
HIS DEATH -- A REVENGE KILLING BY A.D. SKINNER, WHICH PRECEDES
SKINNER AND DOGGETT'S NARROW ESCAPE FROM TWO "SUPER SOLDIER" FBI
AGENTS WHO PURSUE THEM IN AN FBI PARKING GARAGE, ONLY TO PERISH
IN A HIGH SPEED FIERY CRASH. WE SEE SPECIAL AGENT MONICA REYES
ASSISTING SCULLY IN CHILDBIRTH WHILE SIMILAR SUPER-SOLDIER/ALIEN-
LIKE FOLK LOOK ON. WE SEE DOGGETT AND REYES THREATENING DEPUTY
DIRECTOR KERSH WITH AN INVESTIGATION INTO HIS ACTIVITIES
SURROUNDING THE SUPER SOLDIER AGENTS. AND, FINALLY, WE SEE AGAIN
THE TOUCHING REUNION OF SCULLY AND MULDER, WITH THE SON TO WHOM
SHE'S GIVEN BIRTH. OFF THEIR LINGERING KISS, FADE OUT...
